description:
Network Chaos Agent — MPLS/L3VPN Network Failure & Chaos Engineering Injection.

Injects controlled network failures by creating and deleting Kubernetes NetworkFailure custom resources to simulate severe real-world transport outages. Manages BGP session drops, link corruption, MTU clamping, route reflector process crashes, transmission queue starvation, and VRF route target isolation to validate automated root-cause analysis (RCA) and autonomous network self-healing capabilities.
tool_description: Inject controlled network failures, link outages, packet corruption, MTU mismatch, and BGP session drops
